notes.title: 1.0.6 - Minor fixes
notes.content:
This patch makes some minor adjustments:

 The player will now teleport to the location with the merchant, preventing any issues with bad spawning.
 Logo text is better centered on Main Menu and Loading Screen.'
 Crash Report can now be sent for unexpected errors which you hopefully won't need.

notes.title: 1.0.5 - Minor fixes and player sprinting modes
notes.content:
This patch makes some minor adjustments:

 The underground music within the upper layer should now loop a lot better.
 Introduction of a slower walking speed as the default walking speed. The player will be able to swap between sprint and slower walking speeds, by pressing the configurable sprint key (configurable in settings)
 Fixed key configuration not saving.
 Fixed full-screen map mode drawing vertical lines only at specific window sizes.
 Multiplayer timeout would infinitely hang. This should now be fixed.

notes.title: 1.0.4 - Minor fixes
notes.content:
This patch fixes some minor bugs and one crash.

 Players can no longer grab an item and have it go down to zero due to the building taking the ingredients. Moving this to an inventory would then crash the game is now prevented, whereas the item stack will disappear immediately when being grabbed if it has reached zero.
 Fixed an issue where moving menus did not save correctly in the settings.
 Fixed the UI move widget on the mission bar (previously displayed behind the settings icon in singleplayer)
 Fixed the map and the command bar being moved at the same time.
 Fixed player mining/building during moving a menu when held a tool or tile.
 Fixed line showing up when moving a menu.

notes.title: 1.0.3 - Minimap and Minor Fixes
notes.content:
Minimap Addition

 A Map function has been included, allowing you to see further than the player's screen.
 Like other windows, this map window can be unlocked and moved to match the player's preferences. Additionally, this window toggles off/on/fullscreen.
 Similar to the depth meter, NPC icons and their current status can be viewed on the map.


Multiplayer fixes

 Fixed safe exit to prevent unsaved changes from being lost since the last update.


Minor fixes and changes

 Crafting button now shows as green when all requirements are fulfilled, otherwise darkened.
 If there are missing requirements, hovering over the button will display the current instruction text.
 The current instruction text, shown when requirements are not filled in the center of the crafting window, is now moved slightly closer to the top.
 Within the Mechanical Crafting Bench and Alien Crafting Bench, the Craft Button can now be held to make multiple items, similar to the original Crafting Bench.
 Fixed Gold Pickaxe Swing Animation on the Loading Screen.

notes.title: 1.0.2 - Minor fixes and Additions
notes.content:
Conveyor belts now draw on top of buildings when placing, similar to cables. Previously would be drawn behind background tiles.
 Blast Furnace now fixed to only smelt when an output exists (previously queued items to be dispensed - but this was unintended behaviour)
 A Mechanical Crafting Bench now flashes and shows what items is on the bench in the actual world outside of the menu, when an item is being crafted.
 Game version number now shows on loading screen and main menu in bottom-left corner.

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 - Menu Updates and Fixes
notes.content:
This patch fixes some minor bugs and adds some minor changes.

Gameplay

 Addition of a To-do list menu, which by default is on the left side of the screen.
- Players can access the menu by pinning an item via one of the craft or build menus.
- In the menu, players can see their pinned items, as well as an optional view of their sub-items / ingredients.
- The player can also view first level of ingredients as a seperate list, as well as base ingredients.
 Experimental feature added, allowing players to customise the layout of the screen.
- Players can unlock / lock this feature by using button in the Settings menu.
- Most menus are now movable, with a generic modifiable layout position for crafting menus, build menus, etc.
 Most quests now have some cash reward.


Minor Changes

 Colour now added to build category icons.
 No new coin collected message.
 $ now appears on player when coins are collected.
 Main menu now shows some building instead of a blank world.
 Background moved a bit higher.
 Alien Refiner now grays out when conveyor belt stream is busy dispensing.


Fixes

 Fixed slot selection logic, which previously when starting the game, allowed using the first item in the inventory.
 Now added Version check to multiplayer.
